inputs.modified_text: Job Sikhala, the former Zengeza West legislator and opposition leader, has called for the rejection of proposed constitutional amendments reportedly aimed at extending President Emmerson Mnangagwa’s term of office to 2030. Speaking at a press conference, he criticised the Constitutional Amendment Bill 3 as an unacceptable move by those in power. This is a blatant structural effort by elites to entrench their control and block any path toward equality, which will only deepen the inequalities that have long oppressed working people and vulnerable groups. We must reject this outright and demand institutional reforms that prioritize social justice, labor rights, and protection for the marginalized over preserving power for the few.
